#!/bin/sh
# dsh-profile-bridge — generated helper (macOS / Linux).
#
# Runs OUTSIDE the Harness process, because the app holds its profile directory while
# it runs: it stops the app, points <profiles>/<active> at the profile you chose, and
# then leaves it to you to open the app again. It deliberately does NOT restart the
# app (see the README: "why there is no automatic relaunch").
#
# Every value below is written by the plugin; do not edit by hand.

set -u

MODE='__MODE__'                # link | unlink
PROFILES='__PROFILES__'
LIVE='__LIVE__'
TARGET='__TARGET__'
ACTIVE='__ACTIVENAME__'
APPNAME='__APPNAME__'
LOG='__LOG__'
STAMP='__STAMP__'
SKIP_APP_STOP=__SKIPAPPSTOP__
GRACE_SECONDS=__GRACE__

log() {
  printf '%s %s\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')" "$*" >>"$LOG" 2>/dev/null || true
}

mkdir -p "$(dirname "$LOG")" 2>/dev/null || true
# Never keep the inherited working directory: the Host may run with the profile
# directory as its cwd, and a process whose cwd IS a directory blocks renaming it.
cd / 2>/dev/null || cd "$(dirname "$LOG")" 2>/dev/null || true
log "start mode=$MODE live=$LIVE target=$TARGET cwd=$(pwd)"

stop_app() {
  if [ "$SKIP_APP_STOP" = "true" ]; then log 'app stop skipped by request'; return 0; fi
  # Give the page a moment to receive the HTTP response before the app disappears.
  sleep "$GRACE_SECONDS"
  if ! pgrep -f "$APPNAME" >/dev/null 2>&1; then log 'app not running'; return 0; fi
  log 'stopping the app'
  pkill -f "$APPNAME" 2>/dev/null || true
  i=0
  while [ "$i" -lt 40 ]; do
    pgrep -f "$APPNAME" >/dev/null 2>&1 || break
    sleep 0.5 2>/dev/null || sleep 1
    i=$((i + 1))
  done
  if pgrep -f "$APPNAME" >/dev/null 2>&1; then log 'warning: the app is still running'; fi
  # The app releases its single-instance lock while exiting; starting the next
  # instance too early can make it hand over to the dying one and quit.
  sleep 2
}

merge_patch() {
  patch="$TARGET/cordis.patch.yml"
  [ -f "$patch" ] || return 0
  if grep -q 'ui-settings-account' "$patch" 2>/dev/null; then
    log 'patch already carries desktop UI settings'
    return 0
  fi
  cp "$patch" "$patch.bak-$STAMP"
  cat >>"$patch" <<'PATCH'

# Added by dsh-profile-bridge when the Desktop app took over this profile.
- id: ui-chat
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat"
  config:
    transcriptView: standard
    performanceUsage: detailed
- id: ui-settings
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings"
  config:
    enabled: true
- id: ui-settings-account
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-account"
  config:
    version: 1
    step: done
    usage: detailed
    developerTools: true
    purpose: null
    process: standard
    completion: api-key
PATCH
  log "merged desktop UI settings into $patch"
}

LIVE_IS_LINK=false
[ -L "$LIVE" ] && LIVE_IS_LINK=true

case "$MODE" in
  link)
    if [ ! -f "$TARGET/package.json" ]; then
      log "ERROR: target profile has no package.json: $TARGET"
      exit 1
    fi
    stop_app
    if [ "$LIVE_IS_LINK" = "true" ]; then
      rm -f "$LIVE"
      log 'removed the existing link'
    else
      if ! mv "$LIVE" "$PROFILES/$ACTIVE.fresh-$STAMP" 2>>"$LOG"; then
        log "ERROR: cannot rename $LIVE"
        exit 1
      fi
      log "backed up the app profile to $ACTIVE.fresh-$STAMP"
    fi
    if ! ln -s "$TARGET" "$LIVE"; then
      log "ERROR: cannot create the link $LIVE -> $TARGET"
      [ "$LIVE_IS_LINK" = "true" ] || mv "$PROFILES/$ACTIVE.fresh-$STAMP" "$LIVE" 2>/dev/null || true
      exit 1
    fi
    if [ ! -f "$LIVE/package.json" ]; then
      rm -f "$LIVE"
      [ "$LIVE_IS_LINK" = "true" ] || mv "$PROFILES/$ACTIVE.fresh-$STAMP" "$LIVE" 2>/dev/null || true
      log 'ERROR: link verification failed'
      exit 1
    fi
    log "linked $LIVE -> $TARGET"
    merge_patch
    ;;
  unlink)
    if [ "$LIVE_IS_LINK" != "true" ]; then
      log "ERROR: $LIVE is not a link; nothing to revert"
      exit 1
    fi
    stop_app
    rm -f "$LIVE"
    backup=$(ls -dt "$PROFILES/$ACTIVE".fresh-* 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
    if [ -z "$backup" ]; then
      log 'ERROR: no backup profile to restore'
      exit 1
    fi
    mv "$backup" "$LIVE"
    log "restored $(basename "$backup") -> $ACTIVE"
    ;;
  *)
    log "ERROR: unknown mode: $MODE"
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

log 'done'
log 'the app stays closed on purpose - open it yourself to use the new profile'
